name: Flesh and Blood
description: Flesh and Blood is a commercial collectible or trading card battle game using constructed decks, proprietary card text, and direct player conflict. It is centred on hero combat, equipment, attacks, and defence reactions.

content.text: Flesh and Blood is a commercial collectible or trading card battle game using constructed decks, proprietary card text, and direct player conflict. It is centred on hero combat, equipment, attacks, and defence reactions.

Flesh and Blood is represented as a dedicated commercial card-game product with its own deck construction, card effects, and play environment. The source identifies it as a distinct card game rather than an expansion or ordinary playing-card variant.
2 or more players use the table arrangement described for Flesh and Blood.
Constructed Flesh and Blood decks, score area, and enough table space for play.
Each player brings a constructed deck or product-defined deck, draws an opening hand, and prepares any starting character, resource, or play area required by the rules.
